# StudyFree PDF
> Talent Aapka, Rasta Hamara (टैलेंट आपका, रास्ता हमारा)

StudyFree PDF is Bihar and Central India's premier digital study material vault and National Education Policy (NEP-2020) accredited virtual undergraduate internship platform, operated in partnership with Digital Developer Infinity Solution (DDIS).

## Mission & Services
- **Exam Study Notes**: Curated topper handwritten summaries, 10-year chapter-wise solved PYQs, and formula cheat sheets across BPSC (CCE 70th/71st), BSEB Class 10th & 12th Inter (Science/Arts/Commerce), CBSE Board, and SSC CGL/CHSL. Available in Hindi & English medium.
- **NEP-2020 Virtual Internships**: UGC-aligned 4-week and 8-week structured project internships across 4 key university streams:
  - BCA / IT: Full-Stack Cloud Engineering (Next.js, TypeScript & MongoDB)
  - Commerce: Corporate Accounting, Tax Compliance & GST Operations
  - Science: Scientific Computing, Data Science & Statistical Analysis
  - Arts: Public Policy, Technical Content Writing & Digital Communications
- **Verifiable Credentials**: Every internship issues an accredited tamper-proof certificate and 2-page College Viva Defense Dossier with live cryptographic QR verification.
